name: table-viewer-vscode
displayName: XLSX Viewer, Excel Viewer, CSV Viewer & Parquet Viewer (XLS, CSV Preview)
description: Free, no paywall. XLSX viewer, Excel viewer and CSV viewer with SQL: query CSV, Excel and Parquet with GROUP BY and JOIN, even a big CSV of several GB. 1M rows open fast, with sheets, formulas, filter, sort and copy as Markdown. No ads, no license banner. Also XLS and ODS.

tableViewer.maxRows.description: Load at most this many rows per file. Rows past the limit are not read, and a banner says so.

tableViewer.maxFileSizeMB.description: CSV/TSV: read at most this many MB from the start of the file. Also the size limit for streamed .xlsx/.xlsm workbooks. Parquet files are read by row groups, so only maxRows applies.

tableViewer.maxExcelSizeMB.description: Excel files read whole in memory (.xls, .xlsb, .ods and .xlsx under 2 MB) above this size show a message instead of loading. Larger .xlsx and .xlsm files are streamed and limited by tableViewer.maxFileSizeMB and tableViewer.maxRows.

tableViewer.maxCopyRows.description: Copy at most this many rows to the clipboard at once.

tableViewer.autoReload.description: Read the file again when it changes on disk (a script, git, an agent or another editor wrote it). Sort, filters and the sheet stay. The Reload button works either way.

tableViewer.excelFormats.description: Excel and ODS: show cells with the workbook's number format, as Excel does (25%, $1,234.50, 01/10/2026). Sort, filters and copy use the stored values. The toolbar switch changes it for one tab.

tableViewer.maxCompareRows.description: Compare with Git HEAD and Compare with Another Table File: compare at most this many rows per table (per sheet for Excel).

tableViewer.queryMemoryMB.description: Query panel: the most memory one query may keep (groups, sort buffer, the result and the files read for a JOIN), in MB. A bigger query stops with a message. Rows that are only scanned (a 5 GB CSV for a GROUP BY) do not count.

tableViewer.askForRating.description: Ask for a Marketplace rating after 3 files opened without an error on 2 different days. "Later" asks one more time after 7 days, "No thanks" never asks again. It never asks after an error or more than 2 times. Nothing is sent anywhere.

tableViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the right end of the table's status bar. The change shows in files you open next. Nothing is sent anywhere.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Table Viewer
walkthroughs.description: Open Parquet, Excel and CSV files as a table. No Python, no setup.

steps.title: Open a data file
steps.description:
Parquet, xlsx, xls and ods files open in Table Viewer when you click them. For CSV and TSV, click the table icon in the editor title or right-click the file and pick "Open in Table Viewer".
[Find a data file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.parquet%22%5D)

steps.title: Sort, filter and read the schema
steps.description: Click a header to sort. Type in the box under a header to filter (>100, 5..9, =exact, !not). The Schema button shows column types, and for Parquet the full schema, row groups and compression.

media.altText: A 1,000,000 row Parquet file open in Table Viewer, sorted by fare, with the type of each column in its header.

steps.title: Query the file with SQL
steps.description:
Click Query in the toolbar and run a SELECT on the file: GROUP BY with COUNT, SUM and AVG, ORDER BY, LIMIT, CASE, dates, and JOIN with other sheets or with other CSV, Excel and Parquet files by path. Big CSV files are read as a stream. The result opens in the same grid, and Save result writes CSV, TSV, JSON Lines or Parquet.
[Open a data file](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.csv%22%5D)

steps.title: Copy rows as CSV or JSON
steps.description:
Drag or Shift+click to select cells, or click row numbers to select rows. Copy CSV and Copy JSON put the selection on the clipboard. Ctrl+C (Cmd+C) copies TSV for pasting into a spreadsheet.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22tableViewer%22%5D)
